text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's in that bento side dish? What is it?
Could it be... fried jumbo shrimp?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, gimmie one, just one☆

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's literally the main part of my lunch, though?!
And there are only three of them to begin with?!

Fusaichi Pandora and her fellow Umamusume friend
were happily eating their boxed lunches on the grass.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's fine! You've got three of them.
Tell ya what, I'll trade you
one of my satsuma-age for it♪

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, that's totally unfair!!
Fried shrimp!!
And satsuma-age fishcakes are completely different!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Don't be like that♪ Don't you think it's kinda mean not giving any to a cute, genius, fried-shrimp-loving girl like me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Staaaaaare♡

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
........Aaaagh, jeez!!
Fiiiiiine, whatever...!!
Forcing others is uncalled for. No matter how close friends they are, coercing someone into trading their fried shrimp felt like crossing the line.

In the first place, why does her friend
agree to such requests so easily?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh... Then how about you go grab me some fried shrimp from somewhere instead?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My tongue is totally set for fried shrimp now.
Alright then, pretty please with sugar on top♡
I started to object, asking why it had to be me, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pleeaase☆
*teary puppy eyes*♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I'm super serious about wanting to eat it!
You'll go grab it for me, right? Pretty please?

Her spoiled-brat aura—is rushing in!
However—
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try winning it for you...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yikes. Resisting my innocent little favor?
That's seriously such a turn-off~...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll see if someone else has some to spare.
Heyyy, anyone got extra fried shrimp~?

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief.
In the end, someone always gives in and gives them some.
Even knowing they shouldn't...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ That's what I'm talking about!
Umm, maybe there's a local butcher shop around here?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Maybe grab some fresh hot croquettes too while you're at it.
I'll be a good girl and wait for you☆
Wondering why it had to be me, I nonetheless gave in to her innocent request.
